description: Scenario tests for social-strategy. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-strategy
evals.input: Help me build a social media strategy.
expect: reads brand-profile, audience.md, and content-pillars first (or runs them where missing)
sets one primary objective tied to the business, with a meaningful metric
selects 1-3 channels using the fit framework and names what it drops
defines a strategic wedge from the brand's POV
sets a sustainable, phased operating model
writes a social-strategy.md

evals.name: focus-not-everywhere
evals.input: I want to be active on every platform — Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook.
expect: pushes back on spreading thin
selects the few channels where the audience is and the brand can win
explicitly names which platforms to drop or run as maintenance
recommends starting focused (often one primary channel)

evals.name: channel-fit-framework
expect: answers using audience presence, format fit, goal fit, and capacity — not gut feel
considers whether the brand can sustain video content
gives a clear recommendation with the reasoning

evals.name: business-goal-not-vanity
evals.input: My goal is to get to 100k followers.
expect: reframes toward a business-tied objective and a meaningful metric
explains why follower count alone is often a vanity metric
ties the strategy to what the business actually needs (leads, sales, authority, awareness)

evals.name: honest-measurement
evals.input: Set up the strategy and tell me how we'll track performance.
expect: sets meaningful metrics and a review cadence
is honest that WoopSocial has no analytics — measurement is the platforms' native analytics, read manually
does NOT promise dashboards or automated reporting the product can't deliver
routes detailed target-setting (SMART targets, North Stars, thresholds) to goals-and-kpis

evals.name: strategic-wedge-required
evals.input: What's our angle to stand out?
expect: defines a differentiated wedge from the brand's POV/positioning
does NOT settle for 'post good/consistent content' as the strategy
if positioning is too weak to yield a wedge, says so and points back to brand-profile

evals.name: realistic-phasing
evals.input: We're a 2-person team launching on social next month.
expect: recommends starting focused (one primary channel) rather than launching everywhere
matches cadence to the team's real capacity
uses repurposing to extend reach without doubling the workload
lays out a phased expansion

evals.name: subtraction-strategy
evals.input: We're posting on 6 platforms and nothing is really working.
expect: recommends consolidating to the 1-2 channels that fit best
treats dropping/demoting channels as a valid strategic move
redirects freed-up effort to winning where it counts
